summary: Coeur Mining filed an 8-K disclosing the planned retirement of VP/Chief Accounting Officer Kenneth J. Watkinson (effective August 2026 with transition to early 2027) and the appointment of Anne Beckhelheimer as SVP/Tax/Corporate Controller/CAO effective August 10, 2026. No price, premium, or deal terms apply. The change is a planned succession, not forced. The board approved the transition; no advisors named. The filing also covers an approved charter amendment to limit officer liability. Watch for any subsequent material changes or departure of top personnel that could signal deeper issues.
